note: Window agent p0500-p0599, 2 Nov 2026. Fixes: Sasanian keyframes of 510 and 567 drew Khorasan (3 years) and Yemen (8 years) early; Western Wei keyframes of 553/555 cut Sichuan and Chongqing back to nobody; Sui 592 shape drawn from 589; Frankish 509 outline and Chenla 550 start.

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's 510 correction adds Khorasan, Margiana, Herat and Sistan 'from 513' (Cliopatria's 523 shape) but the keyframe starts in 510, so 3,198 cells were taken from the Hephthalites three years early. Kavad I page: after 484 'all of Khorasan was seized by the Hephthalites' and 'Nishapur, Herat and Marw were now under Hephthalite rule'; 'by 513 he had re-taken the region of Khorasan from them' ('A Sasanian coin dating to 512/3 has been found in Marw'). Verdict ok = Cliopatria's 510-522 shape as drawn; the dossier's own 513 gain (ledger/62) and the white-huns 513 loss (ledger/8) hand Khorasan over in 513.

The dossier's 567 correction adds the Himyarite 577 shape 'from 575', but the keyframe starts in 567, so Yemen (1,292 cells) was drawn Sasanian eight years early and taken from the Himyarite Kingdom. Aksumite-Persian wars page: Wahrez came 'with 800 Dailamite cavalrymen in 570 CE' and reinstated Sayf as a Persian vassal; 'By 575-578 AD, the Himyarite vassal king Yazan was murdered'; 'Yemen was then annexed by the Sasanian Empire as a province'; 're-conquered Yemen by 578'. Verdict ok = Cliopatria's 567-576 shape as drawn; the dossier's ledger (vassal 570, gain 575) and its 577 keyframe carry Yemen from 575.

union.text: Xiao Ji's domain, the Sichuan basin and Chongqing (the Liang's Yi Province: 'Sichuan (region)' inside the Southern Qi 500 outline, so without the Tibetan plateau, and north of 28 N, so without the Liangshan and Panzhihua uplands that Cuan and Dengzhi held)

correction.text: the realm with Sichuan and Chongqing (Xiao Ji's domain, taken in 553), Hanzhong and Xiangyang

keyframe_overrides.why: The 553 keyframe is Cliopatria's 536 shape plus Xiangyang, but that outline holds only the western basin; the ledger's own 553 gain of Xiao Ji's Sichuan was cut back by 1,058 cells (790 in Sichuan, 268 in Chongqing), which then belonged to nobody from 553 until the Northern Zhou keyframe of 561. Yuwen Tai page: 'Yuwen sent his nephew Yuchi Jiong to attack Xiao Ji's domain (modern Sichuan and Chongqing)'; 'Most of Xiao Ji's domain fell into Western Wei hands'. The correction adds the Liang-held part of Sichuan (not the western plateau, which the Liang never held).

correction.text: unchanged shape, drawn from 589 (the fall of Jiankang) instead of 592

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's own note says the 592 shape 'should hold from 589, not 592'. Sui dynasty page: 'By 589, Sui troops entered Jiankang (now Nanjing) and the last emperor of Chen surrendered'; infobox area '589: 3,000,000 km2' (the shape is 3.32 M km2). Without the change 1,142 cells of the south (Hunan 350, Guizhou 300, Guangxi 222 and others) belonged to nobody in 589-591 and jumped to the Sui in 592.

correction.text: the 510-522 shape (the Salian realm, northern Alemanni, most of Aquitaine and the Ripuarian kingdom), drawn from 509

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier says its 510 shape is 'valid from 509 instead of 510', and the 500-509 outline (verdict wrong) is 'not used', but the compile snapped the state to the 28,600 km2 Cologne outline at 509, dropping 906 cells (Aquitaine) for one year, then re-added them at 510. Francia page: 'Clovis I unites all Franks: c. 509'; 'Aquitaine in 507'. This entry replaces the 500 keyframe by the 510 shape for 509, so the 509 map keeps Aquitaine.

correction.text: the same outline (Champassak, the Mun valley, northern Cambodia), drawn from 550 instead of 555

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's note says 'The same outline, drawn from 550 instead of 555' (years only), but the keyframe started in 555, so Chenla was a 144-cell disc for 550-554 and jumped by 491 cells. Chenla page: 'The people of Chenla, whose base was Champassak in about 550'; infobox 'Vassal of Funan: 550'; the ruler table lists Srutavarman c. 550-555 as 'Unified Chenla'.

correction.text: the 510 shape plus the Pingcheng-Shengle belt plus Hanzhong and Xinyang; plus the Ordos

keyframe_overrides.why: Continuity with the p0400-p0499 patch (keyframe_overrides northern-wei_476, which runs to 509), which keeps the 433-cell Ordos in Wei hands from 427: the state arrives at 1 January 510 holding it and this keyframe, like the 476 shape, leaves it out, so the Ordos (about 430 of 694 cells) dropped to nobody at 510. Xia page: 'Wei launched a second attack and captured their capital at the Battle of Tongwancheng' (427); Xia ended in 431-432 ('Helian Ding was turned over to Wei and executed'); Tongwancheng 'served as a frontier garrison until the Song dynasty'. The page does not date the Ordos in 510-534 itself; the entry follows the neighbour's reading rather than leaving a hole. [Review 2 Nov 2026: the Yuwen Tai page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yuwen_Tai), in its 533 narrative: 'Heba made Yuwen the governor of the key Xia Province (夏州, roughly modern Yulin, Shaanxi)', so Wei still held Xia Province, the old Tongwancheng country of the Ordos, in 533.]

keyframe_overrides.why: Follows the western-wei_553 and western-wei_555 overrides: the Northern Zhou took over the whole Western Wei realm in 557 (Western Wei page: 'Disestablished: 14 February 557 AD', succeeded by Northern Zhou), and Yuwen Tai page: 'Most of Xiao Ji's domain fell into Western Wei hands' in 553. correction.text: the Cliopatria 523 shape plus the annexed Buyeo land on the Songhua, to 554

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's own ledger gives Goguryeo Buyeo's land (ledger/34 in 491, Buyeo's dissolution in 494: 360 cells in Heilongjiang and Jilin) but the 523 keyframe, Cliopatria's shape 'unchanged', ends north of the Songhua country, so those cells dropped to nobody at 523. Goguryeo page: 'Goguryeo completely annexed Buyeo, signifying Goguryeo's furthest-ever expansion north' (Munja, 491-519); 'Goguryeo reached its zenith in the 6th century'; the Tuchueh 'attacked Goguryeo's northern castles in the 550s and conquered some of Goguryeo's northern lands'. Buyeo page: in 494 'the Buyeo court moved and surrendered to Goguryeo'. The land is kept to 554 and the Cliopatria 555 shape (unchanged) takes over from 555, the decade of the Turkic conquest.
